claim_explainer_line: Claiming lets a developer correct facts, reply next to the records and hear from buyers who ask. It never changes a band. A developer that hasn't claimed is shown as “Invited” with the date, and we never call anyone uncooperative.

lines: Order never follows money. The default sort is lowest delivery risk first. No developer pays us, and no fee we earn ever touches ranking. Nobody can buy a place, above or below anyone.

Only verified facts count. Bands, dates and costs come from records we have matched to HARERA, DTCP or MCA. A price list or photo a developer adds is shown and labelled as theirs, but never used to rank. Claiming a page doesn't move it either.

Bands show in Compare. Buyers see each band side by side with the all-in cost and progress. A buyer who asks for low delivery risk gets two tiles, Low and Moderate, and can remove either. Buyers always see how many projects their filters hid.

meta.disclaimer_line: Our opinion, based on public records. Not a credit rating. Not issued by any RERA.
